method.design: deterministic ten-round range sweep; matched staffing curves with +25% production and +50% promotion; one combined policy applied to a holdout team
limitations: The engine is deterministic, so repeatability is measured but there are no stochastic confidence intervals.
The grid covers three disclosed policy paths, not the full combinatorial decision space.
The holdout policy is fixed in advance and is not an optimizer.
Locked decisions are written through the established replay harness; this measures mechanics rather than API usability.
